nchs_weight_scale_options.interpretation: Stochastic event-process precision; does not measure missing-order bias, residence mismatch, age-tail collapse, or stationary approximation. Not automatic SMM weights.
Sample SD of four annual statistics, no division by sqrt(4), no trend removal. Temporal discrepancy scale, not sampling SE. Unadopted.
Maximum absolute shift after omitting one year from the 2003-06 pooled statistic; deterministic window sensitivity, not SE. Unadopted.
Existing rounded old-cohort-window differences. Can be an explicit diagnostic-only inherited scale, never misrepresented as new early-period uncertainty.
Must state and justify source/model discrepancy assumptions and pin resulting weights; not yet specified.

cps_parity_stock.formula: p0=sum_j omega_j M_j0 / sum_j omega_j M_j; one_given_mother=sum_j omega_j M_j1 / sum_j omega_j sum_n>=1 M_jn
cps_parity_stock.age_window: integer ages40 through44 = continuous[40,45); cells[38,42),[42,46) overlap2 and3 years
cps_parity_stock.qualification: Only an explicit approximate reconstruction. Need select pre-/post-birth timing and within-cell law; four-year age42 alone is not exact. Empirical age40-41/42-44 counts are saved. Model household parity also needs maternal/female unit mapping.

uniform_birth_time_parity_interpolation.status: preferred diagnostic proposal; not implemented or adopted
uniform_birth_time_parity_interpolation.assumptions: Equal pre/post fertility age mass; at most one parity transition during a four-year cell; conditional transition time uniform; household reproductive member proxy for female population

fixed_empirical_age_composition_suppleme.status: supplemental projection; not endogenous age-composition fit

nchs_period_first_birth_flow.available_function: run_e5f_transition_calibration.first_birth_accounting_by_age(evaluation,P), uses g_pre * first-attempt policy * fecundity; period_fertility_diagnostics already returns count-flow mean/share
nchs_period_first_birth_flow.formula: F_j=sum_date sum_state g_pre(date,state,j,n=0)*attempt_prob*success_prob; mean=sum_j (age_start_j+2)F_j/sum_j F_j; share30plus=sum_{start_age_j>=30} F_j/sum_j F_j
nchs_period_first_birth_flow.denominator: first-birth flow, not childless risk set and not female exposure; exposure required separately for all-order female rates
nchs_period_first_birth_flow.existing_scored_observer: e5f_matched_pf_moments.HistoricalMomentObserver calls cohort_timing_moments and must not be reused for new early-period rows
nchs_period_first_birth_flow.stationary_use: One stationary flow distribution can represent pooled2003-06 only under the explicit stationary maternal-population approximation; verify actual evaluation stage and no reweighting
nchs_period_first_birth_flow.calendar: Dated bridge assigns decision t to births t+1,...,t+4. For t=2019 this is2020-2023. Preserve annual weights and align maternal age mapping; no label-only shift.

age_tail_collapse.qualification: Collapse preserves the empirical score but assumes early/late births can be represented by boundary model decisions. It does not create pre18 motherhood or maternal age states.

normalization_and_topcoding.initial_fertility_2_1: Author-selected stationary model completed-fertility normalization. Inherited observer uses literal0/1/2/3+ with top-bin representative3.602359422009. Related renewal law divides topcode-adjusted births by2.1. This is not a measured female periodTFR; normalization and entry identities require separate checks.
normalization_and_topcoding.cps_topcode: FREVER is capped at 5 only for the separate CPS mean-completed-fertility diagnostic. The two certified shares do not use that cap.
normalization_and_topcoding.model_top_parity: Any mean-fertility observer must state its representative top-parity weight. Exact-one-among-mothers is identified from literal parity zero/one masses and is not a sequential second-birth hazard.

algebraic_same_distribution_check.qualification: Algebraic conditional diagnostic only: actual 2.1 normalization and CPS age-window observers need not be the same distribution.

normalization_and_topcoding.high_parity_limitation: One terminal3+ state cannot recover the actual distribution of fourth/fifth births. Top-bin mean is an observer restriction, not an extra realized-birth process.
